How do you, like practically, run a swarm with 1,000 agents?

Our new field report takes a deep dive into how we built PyBot, covering:

> how we nearly broke Git and the Hub
> steering swarms on open-ended tasks
> measuring idea basins to encourage diversity
> new open-source tools to scale swarms and let them communicate

Report on HF: https://lnkd.in/e5U-gMX6
